Types

StaticEvalError = object of ValueError
  ln*, col*: int
StaticKind = enum
  skBool, skInt, skFloat, skString, skNil, skObject
StaticValue = object
  case kind*: StaticKind
  of skBool:
    boolVal*: bool
  of skInt:
    intVal*: int64
  of skFloat:
    floatVal*: float64
  of skString:
    strVal*: string
  of skNil:
    nil
  of skObject:
    fields*: seq[(string, StaticValue)] ## Field name and value, in declaration order. An ordered seq rather
                                        ## than a table so that repeated evaluation of the same expression is
                                        ## deterministic.
